command_line:
set -eu

Rscript --vanilla - <<'REOF'
counts <- as.matrix(read.table("/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/78563173/inputs/dataset_6c9aee06-f81e-4b75-83c8-fd9cb2c49d40.dat", header=TRUE, row.names=1, sep="\t", check.names=FALSE))
counts <- round(counts)

condition <- factor(c(rep("DMSO", 3), rep("CBD_IC50", 3)))
col_data <- data.frame(row.names=colnames(counts), condition=condition)

suppressMessages(library(DESeq2))
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData=counts, colData=col_data, design=~condition)
dds <- DESeq(dds)

res <- results(dds, contrast=c("condition", "CBD_IC50", "DMSO"))
res <- as.data.frame(res)
res$GeneID <- rownames(res)
res <- res[, c("GeneID", "baseMean", "log2FoldChange", "lfcSE", "stat", "pvalue", "padj")]

write.table(res, file="deseq_results.tsv", sep="\t", row.names=FALSE, quote=FALSE, na="NA")
REOF
